_doc: Hand-curated provenance per family. 'original' picks the root image; 'kym_exclude' drops KYM gallery items that are not derivatives of the root (fan art, 'where are they now' photos, tweets about the subject); 'components' are ancestors of a composite root; 'related_not_derived' are same-shoot / same-subject photos that are NOT derived from the root (hard negatives). 'kym_exclude' also applies to Imgflip user memes; items are matched by substring of URL or title.

original.source_note: Stock photo 'Disloyal man with his girlfriend looking at another girl' by Antonio Guillem (Girona, Spain), uploaded to iStock/Shutterstock in Nov 2015. File used here is the comp-size copy archived on Know Your Meme (origin section); the licensed full-resolution file is paywalled. First captioned use: Turkish Facebook page 'Prog Dusmanlarina Verilen Muthis Cevaplar', 2017-01-30 (Phil Collins / pop / prog). KYM: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/distracted-boyfriend ; Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distracted_boyfriend

001/289/193/ff0: Phil Collins / pop / prog caption - earliest widely shared captioned version (Facebook, 2017-01-30), as archived on KYM

original.source_note: Photo of Zoe Roth taken by her father Dave Roth in January 2005 during a controlled-burn fire-department drill in Mebane, North Carolina; titled 'Firestarter', first uploaded to Zooomr on 2007-01-02 and submitted to JPG Magazine's 'Emotion Capture' contest on 2007-11-29 (published 2008). File used here is the early copy archived on KYM (photo id 130); Dave Roth's own upload is no longer online. Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disaster_Girl

families.name: Hide the Pain Harold

original.source_note: Stock photograph of Hungarian electrical engineer Andras Arato at a laptop with a coffee mug, from a series of stock shoots (c. 2010-2011) sold through Dreamstime. The licensed original is paywalled; root file is the low-resolution fair-use copy of that laptop photo on Wikipedia (the frame used by the Imgflip template and almost all macros). Earliest known attention: Facepunch forum thread, 2011-09-13 (user Greenen72 posted the Dreamstime-watermarked photos). The Know Your Meme entry icon is a DIFFERENT photo from the same shoot (Harold on the phone) and is kept as a hard negative. Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hide_the_Pain_Harold

related_not_derived.note: Know Your Meme entry icon: Harold on the phone - a different photo from the same Dreamstime shoot, NOT derived from the laptop root

Different photo from the same Dreamstime shoot (Harold at a meeting, watermark visible) - same subject, NOT derived from the root

000/185/885/SANDCASTLES: 'I hate sandcastles' - the 2008 captioned version that first spread the image (archived on KYM)

original.source_note: Composite meme. First paired on Twitter by @MISSINGEGIRL on 2019-05-01 ('These photos together is making me lose it'). Left panel: still of Taylor Armstrong (with Kyle Richards) from The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills S2E14 'Malibu Beach Party From Hell', aired 2011-12-05 (Bravo), widely circulated via a Daily Mail article on 2011-12-06. Right panel: photo of Smudge the cat posted to Tumblr by deadbefordeath on 2018-06-19. Root file here is the Imgflip template (the clean side-by-side composite); the two source photos are listed under 'components'. Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Woman_Yelling_at_a_Cat

Right component: Smudge the cat at the dinner table, Tumblr (deadbefordeath), 2018-06-19
